  PROBLEM: When a session is IDLE, older than SESSION_WINDOW_HOURS, and its needs_action contains approval-prompt text (e.g., "Approve or deny: Bash(git push origin HEAD)"), line 620 returns "needs_input" before the permission_prompt check at line 624 can fire.
